 Head Coach Brian Schmetzer reveals his lineup for tonight's Audi 2026 MLS Cup Playoffs match against Real Salt Lake (7:00 p.m. PT; Apple TV , iHeartMedia Seattle, El Rey 1360 AM | TICKETS ) on Thursday at Lumen Field. Here is the Delta Starting XI:
 LINEUP NOTES:
 The match is a win-or-go-home fixture, with the victor facing Vancouver Whitecaps FC in the Round One Best-of-3 series. Seattle and RSL split their regular-season series in 2026, each winning its respective home match. 
 Coach Schmetzer makes three changes to the lineup that defeated LAFC 2-1 on Decision Day, with Jesús Ferreira , Stuart Hawkins and Alex Roldan coming into the starting lineup. 
 Seattle enters its 17th postseason in its 18 years since joining MLS in 2009, the most of any team in the league over that span. The Rave Green join the Boston Celtics as the only two teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB or MLS to make the postseason 17 out of 18 years since 2009.
